summary: A scammer sent a small cryptocurrency payment that appeared much larger by exploiting decimal formatting differences then claimed an overpayment had been made and demanded an immediate refund. Fake transaction confirmation images and urgency were used to convince victims to return funds they never actually received.
user_mistake: Trusted screenshots and refund requests without verifying the actual wallet balance.
prevention: Verify the received amount on the blockchain before refunding / Ignore screenshots as proof of payment
